economic_meaning: Treats the whole observed capital target as government investment before private household capital is added.
source_support: Protected source initializes GovInv as Kt0 * param.GovInv_ratio (mpHANK_equilibrium_2000.m:27-40); accepted corrected-2018 evidence records the source-faithful diagnostic specialization GovInv0=Ktarget.
circularity_risk: None for the assignment itself; it does not require a contemporaneous household object.
dimension: GovInv and Ktarget are province total-capital stocks in the same capital unit; HANK_firm uses Kt=Kt_supply+GovInv (HANK_firm.m:14).
Kt_supply_controller_interaction: Any positive Kt_supply is added on top of Ktarget; turn-1 accepted evidence observes this overshoot. The existing controller only changes GovInv after its gated clipped-ra test and has no direct Ktarget residual.
positivity: Preserves nonnegative GovInv when Ktarget is positive.
identification: Historically identified as a source-faithful numerical start; not identified as an economic public-capital share.

economic_meaning: Assigns government investment as the nonnegative residual after the defined initial private capital supply, so initial firm capital equals Ktarget when private supply does not exceed it.
source_support: The accounting identity is source-backed by HANK_firm.m:14 and Kt_supply is constructed from household At*N after the household pass in HANK_mp_1turn.m:31-36. Accepted 25-turn evidence explicitly states the same residual accounting implication, without accepting an implementation.
circularity_risk: HIGH unless Kt_supply_initial is independently frozen before GovInv-dependent price formation. A generic initialized At, a same-year household-pass At under data-consistent exogenous prices, and a lagged/source-faithful prior-state At are distinct objects; inspected material does not select one. A household pass whose prices were themselves formed from the candidate GovInv is circular.
dimension: Ktarget and Kt_supply_initial must be province aggregate capital stocks in the same MU-scaled contract; At must first be converted by N and cross-province allocation exactly as HANK_mp_1turn.m:31-36 specifies.
Kt_supply_controller_interaction: It removes the initial accounting double count conditional on the selected Kt_supply_initial definition. The frozen .9/1.1 controller remains a separate post-pass intervention and could still move GovInv away from the residual.
positivity: The max operator guarantees GovInv0 >= 0, but does not guarantee positive private supply or economic admissibility.
identification: Requires an OWNER_OR_DATA_DECISION_REQUIRED definition and observation point for Kt_supply_initial; it must not be selected by convergence, boundary hits, or target matching after a trajectory.

economic_meaning: Posits an ex ante government share of target capital and leaves the balance conceptually private or otherwise unassigned at initialization.
source_support: Protected source contains a configurable param.GovInv_ratio in mpHANK_equilibrium_2000.m:40, but the inspected protected source and accepted materials provide no external/dissertation authority for a fixed g0 economic share.
circularity_risk: Low algebraic circularity if g0 is externally fixed before model prices; high evidentiary circularity if g0 is chosen from convergence or observed path performance.
dimension: g0 is dimensionless and Ktarget is an aggregate capital stock, so GovInv0 has the required capital unit.
Kt_supply_controller_interaction: Positive Kt_supply again adds to g0*Ktarget in HANK_firm.m:14. The current clipped-ra controller subsequently multiplies the chosen initial value and therefore cannot supply identification for g0.
positivity: Nonnegative for the stated closed interval and positive Ktarget.
identification: OWNER_OR_DATA_DECISION_REQUIRED unless an external public-capital share or series is admitted; convergence-based tuning is forbidden.

formula: GovInv0 = externally justified public-capital stock or share; private component = independently defined household productive At supply
economic_meaning: Separates public and private capital by economic role instead of treating the entire target as public investment.
source_support: HANK_firm distinguishes GovInv from Kt_supply in Kt=Kt_supply+GovInv (HANK_firm.m:14), but inspected protected sources and accepted materials do not supply an admissible province public-capital series or validated public/private decomposition.
circularity_risk: Low only if both components are externally fixed before endogenous prices; high if either component is recovered from the same converged path being evaluated.
dimension: Both components must be aggregate province capital stocks in the same price/year/unit contract as Ktarget; a share is dimensionless only when multiplied by that target.
Kt_supply_controller_interaction: The source identity can accommodate the decomposition, but the extant controller acts on the aggregate GovInv component after return clipping; whether a public-capital stock should be controlled this way is unresolved.
positivity: Can preserve positivity if the external public stock/share is nonnegative; private-supply validity remains independently required.
identification: OWNER_OR_DATA_DECISION_REQUIRED: requires an admissible external series or dissertation-backed definition, not a fitted residual or convergence criterion.
